Any cabin that chooses the Pay in Full option, but does not pay in full within two (2) hours of the booking will no longer be eligible for the discount. To calculate the 10% Pay in Full Now Discount, we will take the listed Voyage Fare minus any additional discounts, and based on that newly discounted Voyage Fare, apply the 10% discount when the “Pay In Full” option is selected during the booking process.
